description: This file defines the Subscription model class in the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling CRUD operations and management for subscription-related data, including adding/editing subscriptions, products, options, and history.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription data in Opencart, including creation, updates, retrieval, and associated product/options management.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Creates a new subscription record in the database using provided data, calculates initial trial and remaining periods, sets next billing date, and adds associated products.

methods.name: editSubscription
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription record with new data, recalculates trial and remaining periods, updates next billing date, and manages associated products.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Updates the subscription's status in the database.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining count for a subscription.

methods.name: editTrialRemaining
methods.description: Updates the trial remaining count for a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Updates the next billing date for a subscription.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByOrderId
methods.description: Removes a subscription record associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription record and decodes payment and shipping methods.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Fetches subscription records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Counts total subscriptions matching optional filters.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Creates a new subscription product record, including options if provided.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Deletes all products associated with a subscription.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products linked to a subscription.

methods.name: getProductByOrderProductId
methods.description: Fetches a specific subscription product by order and product IDs.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds an option to a subscription product.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Removes all options for a subscription.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option for a subscription product.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Fetches all options for a subscription product.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a status change history record for a subscription.

methods.name: addLog
methods.description: Logs an event or error related to a subscription.
